content_metadata.description: A small-town reporter, Emily Morgan, gets a shot at national fame when she auditions to co-host a popular morning show. Navigating professional rivalry and personal history with ex-boyfriend Charlie Fisher, Emily tackles holiday cheer, career challenges, and unexpected romance.

storylines.description: This holiday rom-com follows Emily Morgan, a small-town reporter, as she aspires to make it big on national television by co-hosting a morning show. Along the way, she navigates her past relationship and burgeoning romantic interest, Charlie Fisher, while juggling professional challenges and opportunities.

content_metadata.title: Emily's Big Break
